function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here’s a quick guide on where you can order a cake—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty shop, or an online delivery service.

---

## 1. Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
| City / Region | Bakery / Shop | What Makes Them Stand Out | How to Order |
|---------------|---------------|--------------------------|--------------|
| **New York** | *Magnolia Bakery* | Classic American cakes, famous for banana pudding & cupcakes. | Call or order online via their website. |
| **Los Angeles** | *Baked by Melissa* | Bite‑size cupcakes in unique flavors. | Order through their site or via Instagram DM. |
| **Chicago** | *The Cake Shop* | Custom wedding cakes & seasonal specials. | Phone or email; they’ll set up a design consultation. |
| **London** | *The Little Sweet Shop* | Artisan cakes with British heritage flavors. | Book online or visit in person. |
| **Sydney** | *Cake & Co.* | Vegan & gluten‑free options. | Order online; free delivery within 20 km. |

> **Tip:** Many local shops offer *“order in advance”* for events. Call ahead to secure your slot.

---

## 2. Online Delivery Platforms  
| Platform | Highlights | How to Use |
|----------|------------|------------|
| **Etsy** | Handmade, custom cakes from independent bakers worldwide. | Search “custom cake” + your city; contact seller directly. |
| **Goldbelly** | Curated selection of iconic regional cakes (e.g., Boston Baked Beans, Philly Cheesesteak). | Browse by region; place order online; they handle shipping. |
| **Uber Eats / DoorDash** | Many local bakeries partner for quick delivery. | Search “cake” or “bakery” in your area; choose a shop. |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Ready‑made cakes from major brands, delivered same day. | Add to cart; choose delivery time. |
| **Instacart** | Grocery delivery that includes cake options from local supermarkets. | Pick a store; add cake to cart; schedule delivery. |

---

## 3. Grocery Stores & Supermarkets  
| Store | Cake Options | Ordering Method |
|-------|--------------|-----------------|
| **Whole Foods** | Freshly baked cakes, seasonal flavors. | In‑store pickup or online order via Whole Foods app. |
| **Walmart** | Pre‑packaged cakes, custom orders at select locations. | Order online; pick up in store or have it delivered. |
| **Tesco (UK)** | “Tesco Cakes” – ready‑to‑eat and custom options. | Order online; choose delivery or collection. |
| **Aldi** | Budget-friendly cakes, often seasonal. | Pick up in store; no online ordering. |

---

## 4. Specialty & Custom Cake Designers  
| Designer | Specialty | Contact |
|----------|-----------|---------|
| **Cake Boss (USA)** | Wedding & event cakes, custom designs. | Phone: 1‑800‑C-BAKE; website: cakeboss.com |
| **La Maison du Chocolat (France)** | Chocolate‑centric cakes, luxury packaging. | Email: orders@lamaisonduchocolat.com |
| **Patisserie Valerie (UK)** | Classic French pastries & cakes. | Order via their website or call. |
| **Sweets & Treats (India)** | Traditional Indian sweets & cakes. | WhatsApp: +91‑XXXXXXXXXX |

---

## 5. Quick Tips for Ordering

1. **Check Delivery Radius** – Many local shops only deliver within a certain distance.
2. **Ask About Customization** – If you need a specific flavor, size, or design, confirm availability.
3. **Read Reviews** – Especially for online platforms; look for recent ratings.
4. **Confirm Cut‑off Times** – For same‑day delivery, place your order early in the day.
5. **Provide Clear Instructions** – If you’re ordering for an event, include the date, time, and any special décor requests.

---

### Need a Recommendation for Your City?

If you tell me your city or zip code, I can narrow down the best local bakeries or online options that deliver right to your doorstep. Happy cake hunting! 🍰
